message: Isolated heavy to very heavy rainfall very likely over Coastal Karnataka, Konkan & Goa, and Sub-Himalayan West Bengal & Sikkim during next 48 hours. Thunderstorm accompanied with lightning and gusty winds (speed reaching 30-40 kmph) likely over interior Karnataka, Maharashtra, and North East States.
text: Isolated heavy to very heavy rainfall very likely over Coastal Karnataka, Konkan & Goa, and Sub-Himalayan West Bengal & Sikkim during next 48 hours. Thunderstorm accompanied with lightning and gusty winds (speed reaching 30-40 kmph) likely over interior Karnataka, Maharashtra, and North East States.
advisories: Keep field drainage channels clear to avoid localized waterlogging in paddy fields.
Postpone chemical spraying and foliar fertilizer application during active rain spells.
Move harvested produce and farm equipment to elevated, covered storage.

message: A low pressure area lies over Westcentral and adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal. No cyclonic storm currently active near Indian coastlines. Fishermen are advised not to venture into deep sea areas of Westcentral Bay of Bengal due to squally weather with wind speeds reaching 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph.
text: A low pressure area lies over Westcentral and adjoining Northwest Bay of Bengal. No cyclonic storm currently active near Indian coastlines. Fishermen are advised not to venture into deep sea areas of Westcentral Bay of Bengal due to squally weather with wind speeds reaching 40-50 kmph gusting to 60 kmph.
advisories: Fishermen out at sea along coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha are advised to return to coast.
Secure small boats, fishing trawlers, and offshore farm nets.
Coastal horticultural crops like banana and papaya should be provided propping support against gusty winds.

message: Light to moderate rain accompanied by thunderstorm and lightning with surface winds gusting to 35 kmph very likely at a few places over North Goa and South Goa districts during next 24 to 48 hours.
text: Light to moderate rain accompanied by thunderstorm and lightning with surface winds gusting to 35 kmph very likely at a few places over North Goa and South Goa districts during next 24 to 48 hours.
advisories: Avoid taking shelter under tall, isolated trees during lightning activity.
Postpone pesticide spraying in cashew, arecanut, and paddy plots until weather clears.
Ensure proper runoff channels in low-lying plantation terraces.

message: Moderate rain with occasional thunderstorm and lightning likely over Bengaluru Urban and Rural districts during late evening and night hours.
text: Moderate rain with occasional thunderstorm and lightning likely over Bengaluru Urban and Rural districts during late evening and night hours.
advisories: Unplug sensitive electronic devices and farm borehole motor starters during lightning.
Keep livestock in covered shelters.

state: Maharashtra, Karnataka, Goa, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana
message: Monsoon rainfall distribution remains favourable for Kharif crop vegetative stages. Farmers in paddy tracts are advised to maintain 3-5 cm standing water in main fields. In rain-surplus zones, drain excess water from cotton, maize, and pulse fields.
text: Monsoon rainfall distribution remains favourable for Kharif crop vegetative stages. Farmers in paddy tracts are advised to maintain 3-5 cm standing water in main fields. In rain-surplus zones, drain excess water from cotton, maize, and pulse fields.
advisories: Rice/Paddy: Maintain 3-5 cm water; apply second split dose of nitrogenous fertilizer only when rain is not imminent.
Cotton: Inspect lower foliage for sucking pests (aphids/jassids); avoid spraying if rain probability exceeds 40%.
Vegetables: Provide staking for tomato, chilli, and cucurbits to prevent lodging and soil rot.

state: Rajasthan, Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh
message: No heatwave conditions prevailing over any part of the country. Maximum temperatures are within normal to slightly below-normal range across northern plains.
text: No heatwave conditions prevailing over any part of the country. Maximum temperatures are within normal to slightly below-normal range across northern plains.
advisories: Farming operations can proceed normally during regular daytime hours.
Maintain regular irrigation schedules for late-sown kharif crops.
